caption: The circuit lane pays 0.5 s of setup before its 8 s of data, then 0.5 s of teardown, ending at 9 s. The packet lane starts at once, sends all 1,000 packets of 8 ms in 8 s, and the last packet's two extra hops add only 16 ms, so it ends at 8.016 s.

spec.aria: Two timelines on a 0 to 9 second axis: the circuit bar is split into a 0.5 s setup, an 8 s data phase and a 0.5 s teardown, totalling 9 s; the packet bar runs from 0 to 8.016 s with no setup or teardown, so it finishes slightly earlier.
